name: 22553 · Spotsylvania, VA
findings: ZIP 22553 (Spotsylvania) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22553 (Spotsylvania) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22553 (Spotsylvania) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
